title: ProductUpdated
description: PLANNED (update-product). Published by stores-service via outbox (aggregateType=Product, key=productId) after every PUT that changes the product. A snapshot of the catalog fields consumers need (not description, images or dimensions), not a diff. Consumed by inventory-service ProductUpdatedConsumer (group inventory-product-updated). Consumers apply an event only if its version is greater than the last one applied for the product; ProductCreated counts as version 0.

merchantId.description: Owner of the store, taken from the loaded store (never from the request path).

version.description: Strictly increasing per product; ProductCreated is version 0.

status.description: DRAFT is allowed for the future; today create sets ACTIVE and a product never returns to DRAFT (BR-CAT-10).

skus.description: All SKUs of the product that are not removed. A SKU the consumer knows for this product but that is missing here has been removed (soft remove; its code stays reserved in the store).

id.description: Stable SKU id; never changes for a given code.

sku.description: SKU code as a plain string (ProductCreated uses {"value": ...}). Immutable after creation.

price.description: At most 2 decimals; a whole number when currency is VND.
